chapter: Return to Atlanta and move north
title: Plotting to run away and heading for Atlanta on the highway
summary: Green tells Slim and Shorty he will run home, they back out, and he sneaks out and hitches rides toward Atlanta.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: So Slim and Shorty, you know, we slept in the same bed, and we get to talking at night in the bed, and I say, well, 'Look,' you know, 'every time we make some money, she takes all the money.' And I say, 'I'm going to run away and going home, you know. How far is we away from where we is, you know, where is Atlanta, you know?'

So -- 'How you going go back there, you know, and I said, 'Well, I'm going -- I can go out -- maybe I can get a ride. Maybe I can -- somebody help me ride part of the way, and I just walk, you know, run there, you know. I want to see my mama, you know.'
So we had an agreement. We said, 'Well, yeah, yeah,

we'll do that. We'll do that. Go to sleep now. Go to sleep now. So we'd go to sleep, because they would always look in the room and see if we're asleep or not, you know, something, you know. We'd put our heads under cover and make like we're asleep or something, you see.
So when it came time to run away, see, Slim and Shorty, they didn't want to go. No, man, go to sleep now. It's too late to be going away now.

And I said, well, I'm going, you know, and, see, at this time -- I think that was around 1928, something, see. I snuck out of the house, went out to the road to the highway. I'd ask people which way is Atlanta, Georgia, something, so and so and so. So I got on the highway, and I was fortunate enough, I got about three or four rides part of the way, you know. And the people had to turn off, and I'd get out and walk again, you see.
